findings.title: Upload 'progress' reframed to indeterminate indicator everywhere
findings.where: OD-5, Error handling (File upload), AbsenceForm, ReviewerUploadDialog
findings.detail: All four locations use 'indeterminate upload indicator (spinner + Uploading… state, disabled submit)' with the explicit sentence that byte-percent progress is out of scope because @supabase/storage-js 2.45.4 upload() is fetch()-based and its FileOptions has no progress callback. No stale 'show progress' promise remains.

findings.title: profiles embeds select name only (never profiles(*), never email)
findings.detail: Explicit mandatory rule: every profiles embed on Absences and Reviewers selects name only, never profiles(*) and never email, with the profiles_read using(true) email-exposure reasoning. Concrete embeds in useAbsenceRequests and reviewer cards select only name.

findings.title: OD-4 states anon delivery outcome per published table
findings.where: OD-4 — 'Per-role delivery outcome for every published table'
findings.detail: One explicit line per table: events -> anon receives; task_completions -> anon receives nothing; reviewers -> anon receives nothing. Absence tables noted as unpublished.

findings.title: Size-limit lockstep relies on a human-maintained cross-reference comment
findings.where: attach_size/reviewer_size DB CHECK vs manual bucket file_size_limit
findings.detail: Lockstep is documented but depends on comments at two edit sites rather than a single source. Not blocking. Optional: add the lockstep reminder to the SETUP.md bucket step too.

findings.title: Officer inbox fetch is explicit but unbounded
findings.detail: Scale assumption and created_at desc ordering are now stated; the all-rows fetch remains unbounded, which is a documented deliberate choice at class scale. Not blocking.
